name: code-flow
description: See a Python script, notebook or SQL file as a map of code blocks linked by the variables and tables they pass — including the project's own modules and the CTEs inside queries. Chat with Claude Code about it, follow the debugger, export as HTML.

codeFlow.direction.description: Default layout direction for new maps. Each map can be switched in its toolbar, and the choice is remembered per file.

codeFlow.pythonPath.description: Python 3 interpreter used to parse scripts (a full path to python.exe / python3). Empty = use the Python extension's selected interpreter, then py -3 / python3 / python and the usual install folders.

codeFlow.claudePath.description: Path to the Claude Code CLI (claude). Empty = find it on PATH and common install locations.

codeFlow.claudeModel.description: Optional model for Claude Code (passed as --model). Empty = Claude Code's default.

codeFlow.autoExplain.description: Ask Claude Code for summaries automatically when a map is opened.

codeFlow.timeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait for Claude Code (Explain and each chat answer).
